kind: finite host probes plus source audit

scope.schedules: default runtime, bounded; no custom scheduler
limitations: Mutable payload case lies outside snapshot purity premise

corrections.observation: Caught nested tx failure retains the shared write; uncaught outer failure rolls it back. SQL nesting instead has explicit savepoints.
corrections.action: Keep shared bracket shape separate from nesting and rollback contract.

corrections.target: F5 pure control versus Effect admission
corrections.observation: Catching txRetry allows handler and following effects, but sticky retry flag reruns the outer body.
corrections.action: Either exclude cause-catching retry from admission or specify its flag and replay behavior.

corrections.observation: The model combines left-read retention with left-write rollback and retry-only fallback. In Effect 3.22.2 orElse resets reads and writes and also handles failure; orTry retains writes.
corrections.action: Describe the model as its own proposed alternative and remove exact Effect 3 attribution.

corrections.observation: In-place object mutation survives failure with version unchanged; replacement through TxRef.set is rolled back.
corrections.action: State immutable payload or explicit heap ownership as a target-profile premise.
